description: This source file defines the 'OpenmrsProfile' annotation used in the OpenMRS project. It indicates the classes that should be conditionally created based on OpenMRS version and installed modules. The annotation includes properties for specifying platform version and module dependencies.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfile
classes.description: Annotation interface used to mark classes for conditional bean creation based on OpenMRS version and modules.

methods.name: openmrsPlatformVersion
methods.description: Returns the specified OpenMRS platform version that the class is associated with.

methods.name: modules
methods.description: Returns the list of module names associated with the class condition for bean creation.
